request: Special Order remains Await Customer Confirmation without linked SO; SCM can mark linked PO as sent to vendor, showing Waiting Vendor Confirmation.
scenarios: Reviewed accepted materials without SO stay Await Customer Confirmation, including accepted ETAs and a manually linked PO. New unchecked enquiries retain New enquiry.
A linked SO advances to Confirmed. Explicit test-only SO skips retain the existing testing path.
SCM can mark an active linked PO as sent once. Server stores time and actor and an audit event atomically with the revision. No vendor message is sent.
The new waiting status appears consistently in Sales, SCM, queue filters and database projections. Missing SO, terminal and pending-information states retain precedence.

Existing vendor reference plus queued PO continues the dispatch handoff; already-dispatched requests cannot be sent again. Vendor pickup retains Waiting Vendor Confirmation until completion. This proposed handoff is pending optional user clarification.

Sales, anonymous and backorder requests cannot use the SCM-only action. Missing PO, stale revisions, closed/completed requests and active operations are rejected. Duplicate current-revision retries are idempotent; racing clicks save once.
A changed linked PO clears the sent acknowledgement; the audit record retains the old order.
Regular backorder Confirmed SO/PO linkage remains unchanged.
Migration preserves request/order data and can be reapplied safely; rollback restores the old view without discarding new audit metadata.

failureModel.duplicateOrLostAction: parallel HTTP requests and exact event/revision counts
failureModel.migrationOrRollback: isolated database rehearsal, source/config checks before deployment

setup.git: Preserve dirty workspace; scoped patch over captured live image. No commit/reset.
setup.tests: Standard bounded isolated Compose, mbbs-tests.slice, cleanup registered before startup, remove volumes/network/containers after every run.

amendments.reason: Repository rejects replacing a linked PO. Do not introduce an unrelated capability. Supersedes the different-PO scenario.
amendments.scenario: Relinking the same PO preserves its sent acknowledgement; attempting another PO returns the existing conflict and preserves both original link and sent metadata.
Use the existing vendor-reference and queued PO handoff for Dispatch Arrangement. Vendor pickup remains in vendor waiting until existing completion evidence.

amendments.reason: Expanded regression review found that skipped test orders with accepted ETAs have an earlier Confirmed rule and Backorder shares the stage catalog.
amendments.scenario: Preserve the test-only accepted-ETA milestone and exclude the Special-only vendor-waiting option from Backorder filters.
